activities.subject: Your Product: the offer
activities.text:
# Your Product for North Pier Logistics

Today you pay about $6,400 a month for invoice collections service ($76,800 a year).

Chases your late invoices automatically.

## What you get

- Every late invoice chased automatically
- Built to your requirements, which we go through together after you pay

## The price

Founding customer · 12 months: $24,000.00, paid up front.

## When

Ships within 30 days of payment, built to your requirements.

## What you should know

This product is not finished yet. You are paying now for the version we build to your requirements.

If it has not shipped by the promised date, or we can't build what you asked for, you get every dollar back.

## Next step

Say yes and I will send you a secure Stripe link. Once you have paid, we go through your requirements together, and that is what we build.

Sam Rivera
Your Company
